naslov: AI Wars Ep. 5: Voters reject data centers, OpenAI and Meta go shopping
opis:
In the US midterms, at least 38 of 44 local measures restricting data centers passed, an NBC poll found 76% of voters don't want one nearby, and the $100 million Leading the Future super PAC had little effect. Fewer new data centers likely means compute stays expensive. Meanwhile OpenAI is acquiring Pierre Computer Company, whose libraries power Codex, and Meta bought Conductor, a tool for running multiple coding agents in parallel.

naslov: Gemini Notebook API and MCP: turn web pages and YouTube into AI memory | AI Tool #6
opis:
A REST API and MCP server for creating Gemini notebooks: web pages, YouTube videos, text and Markdown become persistent sources the AI draws on. For now it's a public preview and works only with a personal Google account, not a Workspace account.

How to try it:
1. Open the Quickstart at developers.google.com/notebook and hand the setup instructions to Claude Code.
2. Create an OAuth 2.0 token and set the project ID in the x-goog-user-project header.
3. Send a POST to https://notebook.googleapis.com/v1/notebooks with a display_name, then add a source (e.g. a URL or YouTube video).
4. Optionally connect the remote MCP server to your agent (instructions are in the MCP guide).

naslov: What is an MCP server? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
An MCP server is a standard connector that lets an AI use outside tools and data, like your files, calendar or database. MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. In Anthropic's October updates to Claude Code, MCP servers can now stop in the middle of a task to ask you a question, and plugins can connect themselves.
